races.paceDynamic: Poweracclaim looks the standout pace-setter with minimal early pressure from this 17-runner field, likely to get his own way on the lead through steady fractions. The bulk of the field consists of prominent racers (Verhoyen, Asdana, Polar Bear, Arctic Steps) who will track behind but may lack the early speed to pressure Poweracclaim significantly. Hold-up horses like Sporting Hero, Nouvel Espoir and Verified will find themselves towards the rear in a large field on a sharp 5f track. This pace setup strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can secure good early positions, as the hold-up horses will struggle to make up ground from the back in such a big field over this minimum trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Poweracclaim gets uncontested lead and maintains strong gallop
scenarios.body: The pace-setter controls the race from pillar to post with the prominent racers unable to quicken enough to reel him in. This tactical advantage proves decisive on a track where early position is crucial over the minimum distance.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Asdana or Arctic Steps can travel strongly behind Poweracclaim and produce late kick
scenarios.body: The front-runner comes under pressure in the final furlong allowing the best-positioned tracker to strike with superior finishing speed. Recent winners from prominent positions benefit from perfect tactical setups.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If pace collapses early and field comes back to closers in final 1f
scenarios.body: Sporting Hero or Nouvel Espoir get the perfect scenario where early speed doesn't pay off. The field bunches up allowing the hold-up horses to unleash their finishing kicks from better positions than expected.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider From Midfield
scenarios.trigger: If early pace is truly unsustainable and causes multiple horses to fade
scenarios.body: An overlooked runner like An Laochmor or Skillman Ave benefits from the pace collapse to run on strongly. The big field and frantic early pace sets up perfectly for a horse that avoided the early battle.

races.paceDynamic: Charles Darwin and Kindergarten are both confirmed front runners who will break quickly and contest the early lead. With only 7 runners over 6f, these two will create an honest gallop from the outset, likely going hammer and tongs through the first three furlongs. The sustained pace will expose any horses lacking fitness after long layoffs and set up a genuine test of stamina. This pace scenario strongly favours the prominent racers like Silk Braid, Frescobaldi and Starman Tom who can sit close enough to strike but avoid the early burn-up.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If Charles Darwin and Kindergarten duel early and soften each other up
scenarios.body: The sustained pace will find both leaders out in the final furlong, allowing the prominent racers to sweep past. Silk Braid and Frescobaldi are perfectly positioned to capitalize on their tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Darwin Kicks Clear
scenarios.trigger: If Charles Darwin can establish a clear lead over Kindergarten by halfway
scenarios.body: The Coolmore colt's superior class tells as he finds another gear approaching the furlong pole. His 113 RPR and Ryan Moore partnership proves decisive when the tempo lifts.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Kindergarten Wire Job
scenarios.trigger: If Kindergarten can match Charles Darwin's early pace without cracking
scenarios.body: The Harrington filly's fresh legs from her 199-day break become an asset in the closing stages. She maintains her gallop when others tire after the honest pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold Up Specialist Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace between the front two becomes exceptionally fierce
scenarios.body: Chicago Call benefits from the most patient ride under Ben Coen, conserving energy while others battle. The hold-up specialist times his run perfectly as the pace collapses ahead.

races.paceDynamic: Scandinavia and Dallas Star will both want the lead, creating early pace pressure in this small field. Scandinavia has the superior class and Ryan Moore's tactical nous should see her dictate terms from the front. Dallas Star may press or stalk early but lacks the firepower to sustain a challenge. The strong early gallop will set up a tactical affair where prominent runners like Carmers and Emit can track the pace, while hold-up horses Sunchart, Layfayette and Leinster face the challenge of making ground in a small field with limited pace collapse. This race shape favours prominent racers who can sit close enough to strike but avoid the early speed duel.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Scandinavia Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Scandinavia gets an uncontested lead and dictates fractions
scenarios.body: Moore will control the pace on the class horse, quickening when it suits to put the race to bed. Her superior rating and proven stamina at this trip makes her hard to peg back once in command.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Duel
scenarios.trigger: If Dallas Star genuinely challenges Scandinavia for the early lead
scenarios.body: Both leaders will compromise each other, creating a fast early pace that will bring stamina into play late. The prominent runners tracking the pace will have first run on the tiring leaders.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Challenge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is moderate and the field stays compact
scenarios.body: The closers will get their chance to unleash late runs in a tactical affair. Sunchart and Layfayette have the experience to time their challenges perfectly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Dallas Star Springs Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Dallas Star gets loose on the lead with Scandinavia settling behind
scenarios.body: The outsider could steal a march if given too much rope early, though his modest rating suggests he needs everything to fall right. Any pace pressure will find him out quickly.

races.paceDynamic: Ice Dancer and Emmeleia will contest the early lead, with Ice Dancer showing more reliable front-running form having led successfully at Navan in August. Bloom and the prominent runners Minerva and Chasing Paradise will track closely behind the pace, while hold-up horses Thundering On and Camino Vino will need the race to develop into a strong gallop. With two natural leaders and several prominent racers in a small field, this sets up as an honest pace that should suit the closers. The race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and those with tactical speed to finish, as the early pace battle will set up a strong finish.

scenarios.label: A

scenarios.trigger: If Ice Dancer and Emmeleia engage early and maintain a solid gallop
scenarios.body: The contested pace will soften up the leaders for late-running types, particularly benefiting horses with proven finishing kicks. Thundering On's hold-up style becomes a major asset as the early pace battle unfolds.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Front Runner Dominates

scenarios.body: Without sustained pressure, the leader can dictate terms and prove hard to peg back in the straight. Emmeleia's recent Naas win suggests she has the class to dominate from the front if allowed easy fractions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuine but not overly strong, suiting the prominent runners
scenarios.body: Minerva or Bloom can use their racing experience to track the pace and time their challenge perfectly. These fillies have the class and tactical nous to exploit any gaps that appear in the straight.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Longshot Upset Special
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely or turns into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Camino Vino's fresh legs after 129 days off could be decisive if the race becomes tactical. Long layoffs can work for talented horses dropping back to this level.

races.paceDynamic: Spanish Rising, Pepper Noir, Talk Show Host and Casheldale Lass will ensure a strong gallop from the start with four confirmed front-runners in a 26-runner handicap. The pace will be relentless through the early stages at Navan's 1m2f trip, with the leaders likely to string the field out significantly. This sustained tempo will test stamina reserves in the final two furlongs, creating opportunities for hold-up horses with proven finishing kicks. The strong early pace strongly favours closers who can produce late runs when the pace-setters weaken.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If the four front-runners maintain aggressive fractions through halfway
scenarios.body: The relentless gallop will stretch the field and exhaust the early leaders, allowing patient hold-up horses with finishing speed to sweep past tired rivals in the final furlong. Master Sydney and Justenzia are perfectly positioned to capitalize with their proven late-running styles.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Suits Prominent
scenarios.trigger: If one or two front-runners drop back early, reducing the tempo
scenarios.body: A more manageable pace allows prominent racers to stay closer to the leaders without over-racing, then outfinish the remaining pace-setters. Maeve Brennan and Frank Pickle can position ideally to strike in the final quarter-mile.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Survives Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If Spanish Rising or Pepper Noir can dictate terms without serious early challenge
scenarios.body: The leader can control fractions and kick clear when rivals start their moves, having preserved energy through tactical racing. Spanish Rising's class edge could prove decisive if allowed an easy lead.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos From Large Field
scenarios.trigger: If traffic problems or interference significantly impact the race
scenarios.body: The 26-runner field creates potential for trouble in running, allowing an unconsidered horse to benefit from a clear passage when others are hampered. Any hold-up horse avoiding trouble could capitalize on others' misfortune.

races.paceDynamic: Timeless Charm is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate proceedings uncontested, creating a sustainable gallop that won't crack under pressure. The prominent group of Granville Street, Daboya, Radar Ahead, Juniper Sling, Trubshaw and Plunkett Street will settle just behind but none are aggressive enough to force the pace. With 16 hold-up horses in the field creating a bunched finish, this sets up perfectly for patient types who can unleash late kicks. This race strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce finishing bursts over the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Timeless Charm sets an easy pace and the field remains bunched turning for home
scenarios.body: The sustained kick favours the patient brigade with proven finishing gears. Multiple hold-up types can unleash simultaneously over the final quarter-mile.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent horses can position perfectly and kick before the hold-up brigade
scenarios.body: An alert ride from the second rank catches the field napping before the closers get organized. The winner gets first run and holds on grimly.

scenarios.label: C

scenarios.body: The front-runner's unchallenged position allows energy conservation for a determined final effort. Late challengers arrive too late to reel in the leader.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses fail to track Timeless Charm closely and allow excessive splits
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish with the entire field having chances. Form and class become secondary to tactical positioning.
